en: An old Russian Empire postal card addressed in handwritten Cyrillic script. The printed heading reads in Russian and French, with the imperial double-headed eagle emblem at the top left. It has a red 3-kopek stamp with postmarks dated in May, and several circular cancellation marks. The card side shown is the address side only, with no picture, featuring lines for the recipient's address and a printed note at the bottom indicating that only the address is to be written on this side.
